subject: Billing cadence and payment options for Hosted API – monthly invoice vs card
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@hightower.ai>

Subject: Billing cadence / net terms question for Hosted API

Hi Priya,

Quick procurement question as we kick off evaluation of Redwood Hosted API: what are your standard billing cadences and payment options for production usage? Specifically:

- Can we get a consolidated monthly invoice (to our legal entity) instead of charging a card on file?
- Do you offer net terms (Net 30 / Net 45) for customers with a PO and an approved credit profile?
- If we go with card-on-file + invoice fallback, how does your system decide which to bill first?
- Are there minimums or thresholds for invoicing vs charging the card (e.g., invoices only for committed/reserved customers)?

Also can you share the baseline hosted API rate card so we can model costs (token pricing, embedding units, and any per-request fees)? Procurement will need a sample invoice and your W-9 to route a PO. 

I've attached our PO template for reference.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if it helps.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement
Hightower Analytics
procurement@hightower.ai

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Billing cadence / net terms question for Hosted API

Elena —

Thanks for the clear rundown and the PO template. Quick answers up front, then a short set of next steps we recommend for procurement: 

Summary answers:
- Consolidated monthly invoice: Yes — we can issue a single consolidated invoice to your legal entity for all hosted API usage across projects tied to that billing account.
- Net terms: Net 30 is available for customers on an MSA + billing addendum. Eligibility typically requires a committed monthly or annual spend (we usually qualify accounts at >= $10k/month ARR committed, but we can make exceptions tied to a purchase order and credit review).
- Card vs invoice fallback: If net terms are enabled on the account, invoices will be primary. If there are no net terms, the default is card-on-file. If an invoice remains unpaid past the due date (Net 30) we will issue reminders and then attempt auto-collection on card-on-file unless the account is in an agreed remediation path.
- Thresholds: Ad-hoc self-serve accounts (no contract) are charged to card only. Invoicing is standard for contracted accounts (MSA + PO) or reserved capacity customers.

Baseline pricing (high level, see attached rate card for full SKU list):
- Text generation (hosted): $0.003 per 1K input tokens, $0.012 per 1K output tokens (example model family: rwd-large).
- Embeddings: $0.009 per 1K embedding units.
- Dedicated/Reserved: discounted unit rates with tiered commits (see PDF).
- Volume discounts: 5% at $50k/month commit, 10% at $150k/month, customized for enterprise deals.

We can offer a limited introductory credit or an early-commit discount for the first 3 months while you validate. For the HW-2026-0921 indication, Marcus and I discussed an initial 7.5% committed discount for a 12-month reserved plan (subject to procurement sign-off).

Procurement checklist / next steps we suggest:
1) Sign MSA + billing addendum (we'll send DocuSign link).
2) Redwood provides W-9 and sample consolidated invoice (attached).
3) You issue PO referencing deal id HW-2026-0921 and the MSA.
4) Finance sends billing contact + tax entity details to invoices@redwood.ai.
5) Optional: enable net30 terms after credit review; otherwise card-on-file active as fallback.

I'll attach the public rate card and a draft sample invoice for your team. Marcus will drop into procurement syncs for any discount / pricing detail. Let us know a good time for a short procurement call — we have availability Wed Aug 11 9:00–10:00am PT.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

Thanks, Priya — helpful summary. A couple of procurement clarifications before we loop in finance and legal: 

- Billing entity / tax ID: what legal entity will Redwood invoice (and can you provide your W-9 or local tax form)?
- Consolidated invoice: will the invoice show per-model / per-project breakdowns OR only an aggregate usage line? Our accounting needs per-project line items to allocate costs.
- Month cutoff: what is your monthly usage cutoff (e.g., run through the last day UTC / local)? We need to align PO billing periods with our internal ledger.
- Mid-cycle POs: if we issue a PO mid-month, do you prorate commitments/credits?

We'll attach our PO template again (sent earlier). If you can send the W-9 + sample invoice as a PDF that would help speed approval.

Elena
Hightower Procurement

Elena / Procurement team —

Answers inline below and a couple of confirmations to keep the PO flow moving: 

- Billing entity / tax ID: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  - EIN: 12-3456789 (W-9 attached as part of the standard MSA packet).
- Invoice line items: Our consolidated invoice can include per-project and per-model line items. Each line includes SKU, project tag, usage quantity (tokens/embedding units), unit price, and subtotal. We can also provide a CSV export for your ledger team if needed.
- Month cutoff: Usage is aggregated on UTC month boundaries (00:00 UTC on the 1st). Invoices are issued within the first 7 business days of the following month.
- Proration / mid-cycle POs: For reserved commitments, prorations are applied pro rata from the PO effective date to the month boundary. Ad-hoc usage will appear on the next monthly invoice.

Notes on payment flow:
- If Net 30 is approved and enabled for your billing account, invoices will be primary and due 30 days from the invoice date.
- If Net terms are not enabled (or if a specific invoice is disputed/late beyond the remediation window), card-on-file will be used to attempt collection after notices are sent — we will not auto-charge a card if an active and approved PO + Net terms are in place.

Attached: sample consolidated invoice PDF and our W-9 (included in the DocuSign MSA packet). I'll also share a HubSpot deal link for the procurement tracker.

Next steps:
- I'll send the DocuSign MSA + billing addendum for countersignature today.
- Please return a signed PO referencing HW-2026-0921 and email billing contact to invoices@redwood.ai.
- We’ll provision Net 30 after credit review (usually 3–5 business days).

Happy to cover any further detail on the call Wed Aug 11 9:00am PT — Marcus will join to go over the rate-card line items.

Thanks,
Priya
Redwood Inference
